_doc: T-284 (the owner: 'MAKE THE ZOMBIES MORE TERRIFYING'): presentation only. Nothing here is read by gameplay: no speed, damage, timing, hitbox, navmesh, spawn or AI value. Zombie.t284_terror (CZ_T284_OFF=1) switches all of it off. Distances are metres from the local camera; per-zombie work runs only for bodies animated at the full rate (within the T-283 LOD's 12 m and in view).

look._doc: inst_terror on the skin shader: x eye glow, y wet sheen, z rot, w the eyes' colour mix (0 Nachtglas violet, 1 sickly amber). Rolled per body from its look seed (co-op peers agree).

first_sight._doc: The first time a body that is animated at the full rate (near, in view) is in a chasing state: a head snap toward its target and an arm jerk (the hit springs, additive), the look-at snaps for a moment, and a scream unless another scream played within scream_gap_s.

twitch._doc: Small involuntary head jerks and arm spasms (the hit springs) every few seconds, full-rate bodies only; a joint crack within crack_m now and then.

voice._doc: Layers on the existing groans: a low growl under each groan within growl_m, wet mouth sounds within wet_m, ragged breathing from the nearest body within breath_m.

death._doc: A gurgle and a gout of blood from the mouth on a death within near_m (queued with T-283's death effects, never in the frame of the kill).

horde._doc: When at least enter_count bodies stand within radius_m of the local player: a low swell of sound (once per gap_s), the fog thickens by fog_mult over fog_in_s and up to max_lamps lamps within lamp_m flicker; it ends below exit_count for exit_s.
